source: https://darglobal.co.uk/projects (project index __NEXT_DATA__ + each project page's official description)
method: Read in a standard browser session; no bot challenge was solved or bypassed. Text below is taken from DarGlobal's own pages (shortened, not rewritten). DarGlobal does not publish prices on these pages, so no prices are recorded.

projects.title: Trump International Hotel & Tower Dubai
projects.description: The Middle East's first Trump hotel and residences in Dubai. Every unit has sea or Burj Khalifa views, with the world's highest pool. Located on Sheikh Zayed Road at the entrance of Downtown, with direct access to Downtown, Dubai Mall and the Dubai Fountains.

projects.title: D-Villas at Jumeirah Golf Estates
projects.description: Luxury villas in Jumeirah Golf Estates, Dubai's premier golf destination, with exclusive access to world-class golf courses, premium leisure facilities and a vibrant community lifestyle.

projects.title: The Astera, Interiors by Aston Martin
projects.description: A beachfront residential development on Al Marjan Island, Ras Al Khaimah. One- to three-bedroom apartments and three-bedroom beach villas from 61 to 265 sqm, with Aston Martin-designed interiors and direct access to the beach.

projects.title: DG1
projects.description: Luxury apartments in Business Bay, Dubai, with 1-3 bedroom units, a sky garden, gym and yoga studio. The twisting tower was designed by Gensler Architects.

projects.title: Da Vinci Tower, Interiors by Pagani
projects.description: The world's first Pagani residences: a branded tower offering 2-4 bedroom marble-accented homes with private outdoor areas and panoramic views of the canal, Downtown Dubai and the Burj Khalifa.

projects.title: Urban Oasis by Missoni
projects.description: A completed Missoni-branded residential tower on the Dubai Canal with 360-degree city views, private elevators and one- to three-bedroom residences and penthouses. The project is sold out and fully completed.

projects.title: W Residences
projects.description: A completed W Hotels-branded residential tower in Downtown Dubai with views of the Burj Khalifa, the Dubai Fountain and the Dubai Canal, steps from Dubai Mall. Sold out and delivered; buyers can enquire about the secondary market.

projects.title: The Pagani Penthouse
projects.description: Part of DarGlobal's Premiere Edition (1of1) collection: a one-of-a-kind Pagani penthouse in Dubai inspired by Italian supercars, with sleek interiors and city views.

projects.title: Top of the Astera
projects.description: A one-of-a-kind residence at the top of The Astera on Al Marjan Island, part of DarGlobal's Premiere Edition (1of1) collection of ultra-rare branded homes.

projects.title: Tierra Viva, Design inspired by Automobili Lamborghini
projects.description: An ultra-luxury gated villa community in the hills of Benahavís with design inspired by Automobili Lamborghini. A limited collection of villas from 700 to 1,450 sqm with panoramic Mediterranean views, 15 minutes from Marbella and minutes from Puerto Banús and 12 golf clubs.

projects.title: Painite Villas, Design inspired by Automobili Lamborghini
projects.description: Luxury villas in Benahavís featuring the Lamborghini Sky Car Lift, sleek interiors and panoramic Mediterranean views over Marbella's hills. Part of the Premiere Edition collection.

projects.title: Marea, Interiors by Missoni
projects.description: An exclusive gated community within the Finca Cortesin estate offering two- to four-bedroom residences from 223 to 553 sqm, Missoni-designed interiors and a 270-degree panorama from Marbella to Gibraltar and Morocco, with 24/7 security.

projects.title: Les Vagues by Elie Saab
projects.description: A branded seafront complex on Qetaifan Island North, Doha. One- to three-bedroom residences from 86 to 389 sqm with Elie Saab interiors; the island offers private beaches, a marina, a water park and an 18-hole golf course.

projects.title: Trump International Simaisma, Qatar
projects.description: Developed with The Trump Organization in collaboration with Qatari Diar, set within the 8 million sqm Simaisma destination with 7 km of waterfront and access to golf, marina, leisure, dining and retail, plus a residents' Community Centre and Beach Club.

projects.title: Trump International Hotel, Oman
projects.description: Ownership of hotel rooms and suites within the Trump International Hotel, Oman, with professional management. The resort includes a luxury hotel, furnished residences, a championship golf course and a members-only club; owners can enjoy two weeks a year of personal use.

projects.title: Trump Cliff Villas
projects.description: Fully furnished three-bedroom villas beside the Trump International Hotel at AIDA, 130 metres above the Muscat Riviera. Each villa (128 to 166 sqm) has a private pool overlooking the sea, and owners receive a Golf Club Social Membership.

projects.title: Trump Golf Villas
projects.description: Five-bedroom villas along the Trump International Championship Golf Course at AIDA, Muscat, 130 metres above the Riviera with golf and sea views. Each villa from 4,367 sqft comes with a branded golf cart.

projects.title: AIDA
projects.description: A gated hilltop community and golfing destination in Muscat, 130 metres above sea level, blending coastal living, golf and nature. Home to DarGlobal's Trump, Marriott, Fendi Casa and other AIDA collections.

projects.title: Fairway Villas
projects.description: Four- and five-bedroom villas overlooking the championship golf course at AIDA, close to the Ritz-Carlton, Shangri-La, Nikki Beach and Jumeirah hotels.

projects.title: Azure Oceanfront Villas, Interiors by Fendi Casa
projects.description: Oceanfront villas at AIDA with Fendi Casa designer interiors, ocean views and branded amenities, part of the Premiere Edition collection.

projects.title: Amour Sans Détour
projects.description: Fully furnished three-bedroom villas inside AIDA, 130 metres above the sea, ready to use as a private retreat or as a managed vacation rental.

projects.title: Amour Sans Détour 2
projects.description: The second collection of furnished three-bedroom Amour Sans Détour villas at AIDA, with optional rental management.

projects.title: The Great Escape
projects.description: A residential complex within AIDA that rises out of the cliff edges, steps from the ocean, offering one- to three-bedroom apartments.

projects.title: The Great Escape 2
projects.description: A nine-storey building next to The Great Escape at the edge of the cliffs, with one- to three-bedroom apartments and an organic design inspired by the sea.

projects.title: Coastal Investment Villas
projects.description: Three-bedroom villas at AIDA positioned close to the sea, 25 minutes from Muscat International Airport, presented as a coastal investment opportunity.

projects.title: Sunrise Haven
projects.description: Fully furnished beach villas at AIDA with sea views and golf course access, for personal use or as a managed vacation rental.

projects.title: Marriott Residences, AIDA
projects.description: Fully furnished one- to three-bedroom Marriott-branded apartments at AIDA, Muscat, with delivery planned for September 2029.

projects.title: Nickelodeon Hotels & Resorts
projects.description: A family resort destination at AIDA with Nickelodeon character experiences, splash zones and premium hospitality.

projects.title: The Mulliner
projects.description: A five-bedroom residence at 149 Old Park Lane that keeps the building's classical and Art Nouveau features while adding modern technology, premium finishes and top-tier security.

projects.title: 7 & 8 Albert Hall Mansions
projects.description: A one-of-a-kind residence in Albert Hall Mansions overlooking Hyde Park, part of DarGlobal's Premiere Edition collection.

projects.title: Trump Park Residences
projects.description: A limited collection of 2-, 3- and 4-bedroom apartments and 3- and 4-bedroom estate-style townhouses set around a private park of over 7,000 sqm, with a members-only performance and wellness club.

projects.title: Trump Executive Residences
projects.description: Premium furnished Trump residences at Trump Plaza Jeddah, one corridor away from offices, wellness, entertainment, dining and everyday essentials.

projects.title: Amaya Plots
projects.description: Construction-ready luxury plots within the 1,000,000 sqm Amaya master plan in central Jeddah, on the new Al-Amal Avenue linking the Historic Old City to King Abdulaziz Road.

projects.title: Padel Living Residences
projects.description: Contemporary residences on King Abdulaziz Road in central Jeddah with exclusive rooftop padel courts for residents, bookable 24/7 through a dedicated app.

projects.title: Neptune, Interiors by Mouawad
projects.district: North Riyadh, near the Expo 2030 site
projects.description: An exclusive collection of branded five-bedroom villas in north Riyadh near the Expo 2030 site, with interiors by the jewellery house Mouawad and built-up areas from 300 to 420 sqm.

projects.title: Trump Tower Jeddah
projects.description: A 47-floor Trump-branded seafront tower on the Jeddah Corniche. Apartments and penthouses from 70 to 365 sqm (one to four bedrooms) with uninterrupted Red Sea views, plus the Trump Private Club with dining, gym, pool and 24/7 concierge.

projects.title: Trump Mansions
projects.description: A limited collection of Trump-branded mansions inside Rayana, Wadi Safar's double-gated community overlooking the championship golf course.

projects.title: DarGlobal Mansions, Interiors by Fendi Casa
projects.description: An exclusive collection of just seven mansions in a gated community at Rayana, Wadi Safar, Diriyah, combining Saudi architecture with Fendi Casa interiors.
